v0.0.4.description:
# v0.0.4
## Changes
- Added Pistol as a necessary weapon in Target Missions - Step 1: Office Raid
- (Removed until 0.6.8) Goal is included in the apworld (useful for trackers I think)

## New Yaml Options!!!:
- Amount of medals needed to goal
- Types of medals to be used as checks (bronze,silver,gold,platinum,developer)
- Amount of Arcade levels to be included
- True/False send out lower medals when completing level
- Minimum Medals. If you set each medal to a random chance to be included this will make sure no less than this number will be rolled

## More Info
Seems to have an issue with Universal Tracker. Not sure if that is just me or if the apworld doesn't work well with it

Compatible with v0.0.4 Client
Client: https://github.com/Marsavue/DuckGameRebuiltArchipelago/releases
